Sources & methods

Where the numbers come from

  • BPS — Statistics Indonesia (bps.go.id): GDP and growth, consumer prices, unemployment (Sakernas), poverty, population census and estimates, HDI, Gini ratio. Every headline figure on this page is a published BPS aggregate.
  • Bank Indonesia (bi.go.id): the BI policy rate.
  • United Nations population estimates: the median-age figure, labelled approximate.

How to read this site

  • Figures marked approx. are rounded or estimated from published aggregates; everything else is the official published value for the year shown.
  • Unemployment is the August open unemployment rate; poverty is the September rate; inflation is the December year-on-year rate — each series uses the same month every year so the years compare like with like.
  • Provincial populations are from the 2020 Population Census, the latest census; the 2024 national total is the BPS mid-year estimate.
  • This site is a static page: it makes no network requests and works offline from its own files.

Statistik Indonesia — an independent dashboard of published official statistics. Not affiliated with BPS or the Government of Indonesia.

Figures as published by BPS — Statistics Indonesia and Bank Indonesia; reference years shown beside each figure. Last updated November 2026.

Figures are published BPS aggregates (see the Sources section); values marked approx. are rounded estimates. */ 'use strict'; /* ---- Data: BPS — Statistics Indonesia, 2019–2024 ---- */ const YEARS = [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]; const INDICATORS = { growth: { title: 'GDP growth, 2019–2024', sub: 'Real GDP growth, percent year on year · BPS', unit: '%', values: { 2019: 5.02, 2020: -2.07, 2021: 3.70, 2022: 5.31, 2023: 5.05, 2024: 5.03 }, format: (v) => v.toFixed(2) + '%', readout: (y, v) => 'In ' + y + ', real GDP grew ' + v.toFixed(2) + '% year on year.' }, inflation: { title: 'Inflation, 2019–2024', sub: 'Consumer price index, December year on year (%) · BPS', unit: '%', values: { 2019: 2.72, 2020: 1.68, 2021: 1.87, 2022: 5.51, 2023: 2.61, 2024: 1.57 }, format: (v) => v.toFixed(2) + '%', readout: (y, v) => 'In December ' + y + ', consumer prices were ' + v.toFixed(2) + '% higher than a year earlier.' }, unemployment: { title: 'Unemployment, 2019–2024', sub: 'Open unemployment rate, August of each year (%) · BPS Sakernas', unit: '%', values: { 2019: 5.28, 2020: 7.07, 2021: 6.49, 2022: 5.86, 2023: 5.32, 2024: 4.91 }, format: (v) => v.toFixed(2) + '%', readout: (y, v) => 'In August ' + y + ', the open unemployment rate was ' + v.toFixed(2) + '%.' }, poverty: { title: 'Poverty rate, 2019–2024', sub: 'Share of population below the poverty line, September (%) · BPS', unit: '%', values: { 2019: 9.22, 2020: 10.19, 2021: 9.71, 2022: 9.57, 2023: 9.36, 2024: 8.57 }, format: (v) => v.toFixed(2) + '%', readout: (y, v) => 'In September ' + y + ', ' + v.toFixed(2) + '% of Indonesians lived below the poverty line.' } }; /* GDP shares by sector, 2024, percent of nominal GDP (approx., BPS). */ const SECTORS = [ ['Manufacturing', 18.9], ['Wholesale & retail trade', 12.9], ['Agriculture, forestry & fishing', 12.5], ['Construction', 9.9], ['Mining & quarrying', 9.4], ['Transport & storage', 6.1], ['Information & communication', 4.5], ['Financial services', 4.1] ]; /* Largest provinces, Population Census 2020 (millions), BPS. */ const PROVINCES = [ { name: 'West Java', pop: 48.27, island: 'Java' }, { name: 'East Java', pop: 40.67, island: 'Java' }, { name: 'Central Java', pop: 36.52, island: 'Java' }, { name: 'North Sumatra', pop: 14.80, island: 'Sumatra' }, { name: 'Banten', pop: 11.90, island: 'Java' }, { name: 'Jakarta', pop: 10.56, island: 'Java' }, { name: 'South Sulawesi', pop: 9.07, island: 'Sulawesi' }, { name: 'Lampung', pop: 9.01, island: 'Sumatra' }, { name: 'South Sumatra', pop: 8.47, island: 'Sumatra' }, { name: 'Riau', pop: 6.39, island: 'Sumatra' }, { name: 'West Sumatra', pop: 5.53, island: 'Sumatra' }, { name: 'West Nusa Tenggara', pop: 5.32, island: 'Lesser Sunda' } ]; const CENSUS_TOTAL = 270.20; /* million, 2020 census */ /* ---- Small canvas chart helpers (no libraries, no network) ---- */ function cssVar(name) { return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim(); } function setupCanvas(canvas) { const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1; const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const width = Math.max(280, Math.round(rect.width)); const height = parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('height'), 10) || 300; canvas.width = width * dpr; canvas.height = height * dpr; canvas.style.height = height + 'px'; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0); return { ctx, width, height }; } function niceTicks(min, max, count) { const span = max - min || 1; const step = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(span / count))); const candidates = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10]; let best = step; for (const c of candidates) { if (span / (step * c) <= count + 0.5) { best = step * c; break; } best = step * c; } const lo = Math.floor(min / best) * best; const ticks = []; for (let v = lo; v <= max + 1e-9; v += best) ticks.push(Math.round(v * 100) / 100); return ticks; } function drawBarLineChart(canvas, labels, values, opts) { const { ctx, width, height } = setupCanvas(canvas); const ink = cssVar('--ink') || '#16222e'; const muted = cssVar('--muted') || '#5b6b7a'; const grid = cssVar('--grid') || '#e6ebef'; const bar = cssVar('--bar') || '#0e7c7b'; const neg = cssVar('--bar-neg') || '#c8102e'; const padL = 46, padR = 14, padT = 26, padB = 30; const plotW = width - padL - padR, plotH = height - padT - padB; const min = Math.min(0, ...values), max = Math.max(0, ...values); const span = (max - min) || 1; const y = (v) => padT + (1 - (v - min) / span) * plotH; const x = (i) => padL + (i + 0.5) * (plotW / labels.length); ctx.font = '12px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; for (const t of niceTicks(min, max, 5)) { ctx.strokeStyle = grid; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, y(t)); ctx.lineTo(width - padR, y(t)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = muted; ctx.fillText(opts.formatTick ? opts.formatTick(t) : String(t), padL - 8, y(t)); } /* zero line */ ctx.strokeStyle = muted; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, y(0)); ctx.lineTo(width - padR, y(0)); ctx.stroke(); const bw = Math.min(46, (plotW / labels.length) * 0.58); values.forEach((v, i) => { const bx = x(i) - bw / 2; ctx.fillStyle = v < 0 ? neg : bar; const top = Math.min(y(v), y(0)); const h = Math.max(2, Math.abs(y(v) - y(0))); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(bx, top, bw, h, 3); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom'; ctx.fillText(opts.formatValue(v), x(i), top - 4); }); ctx.fillStyle = muted; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'top'; labels.forEach((lab, i) => ctx.fillText(lab, x(i), height - padB + 8)); /* highlight the focused year, if any */ if (opts.focusIndex != null && opts.focusIndex >= 0) { ctx.strokeStyle = cssVar('--red') || '#c8102e'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeRect(x(opts.focusIndex) - bw / 2 - 5, padT - 4, bw + 10, plotH + 8); } } function drawHBarChart(canvas, rows, opts) { const { ctx, width, height } = setupCanvas(canvas); const ink = cssVar('--ink') || '#16222e'; const muted = cssVar('--muted') || '#5b6b7a'; const bar = cssVar('--bar') || '#0e7c7b'; const max = Math.max(...rows.map((r) => r[1])); const labelW = opts.labelWidth || 168; const padR = 64, padT = 8, rowH = (height - padT - 8) / rows.length; ctx.font = '12px -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif'; rows.forEach(([label, value], i) => { const cy = padT + i * rowH + rowH / 2; const bw = ((width - labelW - padR) * value) / max; ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.fillText(label, labelW - 10, cy); ctx.fillStyle = bar; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(labelW, cy - Math.min(15, rowH * 0.32), Math.max(2, bw), Math.min(30, rowH * 0.64), 3); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = muted; ctx.textAlign = 'left'; ctx.fillText(opts.formatValue(value), labelW + bw + 8, cy); }); } /* ---- Page state and interactions ---- */ const state = { indicator: 'growth', range: 'all', focusYear: 2024, provinceQuery: '', provinceSort: { key: 'pop', dir: -1 } }; function visibleYears() { return state.range === 'recent' ? YEARS.filter((y) => y >= 2021) : YEARS.slice(); } function renderMainChart() { const ind = INDICATORS[state.indicator]; const years = visibleYears(); const values = years.map((y) => ind.values[y]); document.getElementById('chart-title').textContent = ind.title; document.getElementById('chart-sub').textContent = ind.sub; drawBarLineChart(document.getElementById('main-chart'), years.map(String), values, { formatValue: ind.format, formatTick: (t) => t + '%', focusIndex: years.indexOf(state.focusYear) }); document.getElementById('chart-readout').innerHTML = ind.readout(state.focusYear, ind.values[state.focusYear]); } function renderSectorChart() { drawHBarChart(document.getElementById('sector-chart'), SECTORS, { formatValue: (v) => v.toFixed(1) + '%' }); } function renderPovertyChart() { const years = YEARS; drawBarLineChart(document.getElementById('poverty-chart'), years.map(String), years.map((y) => INDICATORS.poverty.values[y]), { formatValue: (v) => v.toFixed(2) + '%', formatTick: (t) => t + '%', focusIndex: years.indexOf(state.focusYear) }); } function renderProvinceChart() { const top = PROVINCES.slice(0, 10); drawHBarChart(document.getElementById('province-chart'), top.map((p) => [p.name, p.pop]), { formatValue: (v) => v.toFixed(2) + 'm' }); } function renderYearTable() { const tbody = document.querySelector('#year-table tbody'); tbody.innerHTML = ''; YEARS.slice().reverse().forEach((y) => { const tr = document.createElement('tr'); if (y === state.focusYear) tr.classList.add('focused'); tr.tabIndex = 0; const cells = [ y, INDICATORS.growth.values[y].toFixed(2), INDICATORS.inflation.values[y].toFixed(2), INDICATORS.unemployment.values[y].toFixed(2), INDICATORS.poverty.values[y].toFixed(2) ]; cells.forEach((c, i) => { const td = document.createElement(i === 0 ? 'th' : 'td'); if (i === 0) td.scope = 'row'; if (i > 0) td.className = 'num'; td.textContent = c; tr.appendChild(td); }); tr.addEventListener('click', () => setFocusYear(y)); tr.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); setFocusYear(y); } }); tbody.appendChild(tr); }); } function setFocusYear(year) { state.focusYear = year; const sel = document.getElementById('year-select'); if (sel.value !== String(year)) sel.value = String(year); document.querySelectorAll('.kpi-year').forEach((el) => { el.textContent = year; }); document.getElementById('kpi-growth').textContent = INDICATORS.growth.values[year].toFixed(2) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-inflation').textContent = INDICATORS.inflation.values[year].toFixed(2) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-unemployment').textContent = INDICATORS.unemployment.values[year].toFixed(2) + '%'; document.getElementById('kpi-poverty').textContent = INDICATORS.poverty.values[year].toFixed(2) + '%'; renderMainChart(); renderPovertyChart(); renderYearTable(); } function sortedProvinces() { const q = state.provinceQuery.trim().toLowerCase(); const rows = PROVINCES.filter((p) => !q || p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.island.toLowerCase().includes(q)); const { key, dir } = state.provinceSort; rows.sort((a, b) => { const av = key === 'share' ? (a.pop / CENSUS_TOTAL) * 100 : a[key]; const bv = key === 'share' ? (b.pop / CENSUS_TOTAL) * 100 : b[key]; if (typeof av === 'string') return dir * av.localeCompare(bv); return dir * (av - bv); }); return rows; } function renderProvinceTable() { const tbody = document.querySelector('#province-table tbody'); const rows = sortedProvinces(); tbody.innerHTML = ''; rows.forEach((p) => { const tr = document.createElement('tr'); const name = document.createElement('td'); name.textContent = p.name; const pop = document.createElement('td'); pop.className = 'num'; pop.textContent = p.pop.toFixed(2); const share = document.createElement('td'); share.className = 'num'; share.textContent = ((p.pop / CENSUS_TOTAL) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'; const island = document.createElement('td'); island.textContent = p.island; tr.append(name, pop, share, island); tbody.appendChild(tr); }); document.getElementById('province-count').textContent = rows.length === PROVINCES.length ? 'Showing the 12 largest of 38 provinces. The remaining 26 provinces hold ' + (CENSUS_TOTAL - PROVINCES.reduce((s, p) => s + p.pop, 0)).toFixed(2) + ' million people combined.' : 'Showing ' + rows.length + ' of 12 listed provinces matching your search.'; document.querySelectorAll('#province-table .sort-btn').forEach((btn) => { btn.classList.remove('sorted-asc', 'sorted-desc'); if (btn.dataset.key === state.provinceSort.key) { btn.classList.add(state.provinceSort.dir === 1 ? 'sorted-asc' : 'sorted-desc'); } }); } function renderAllCharts() { renderMainChart(); renderSectorChart(); renderPovertyChart(); renderProvinceChart(); } function init() { /* Indicator tabs */ document.querySelectorAll('[data-indicator]').forEach((btn) => { btn.addEventListener('click', () => { state.indicator = btn.dataset.indicator; document.querySelectorAll('[data-indicator]').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn)); renderMainChart(); }); }); /* Range tabs */ document.querySelectorAll('.range-tab').forEach((btn) => { btn.addEventListener('click', () => { state.range = btn.dataset.range; document.querySelectorAll('.range-tab').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn)); renderMainChart(); }); }); /* Year selector */ document.getElementById('year-select').addEventListener('change', (e) => { setFocusYear(parseInt(e.target.value, 10)); }); /* Province search + sorting */ document.getElementById('province-search').addEventListener('input', (e) => { state.provinceQuery = e.target.value; renderProvinceTable(); }); document.querySelectorAll('#province-table .sort-btn').forEach((btn) => { btn.addEventListener('click', () => { const key = btn.dataset.key; if (state.provinceSort.key === key) { state.provinceSort.dir = -state.provinceSort.dir; } else { state.provinceSort = { key, dir: key === 'name' || key === 'island' ? 1 : -1 }; } renderProvinceTable(); }); }); /* Theme toggle */ const toggle = document.getElementById('theme-toggle'); toggle.addEventListener('click', () => { const dark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') !== 'dark'; document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', dark ? 'dark' : 'light'); toggle.textContent = dark ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode'; toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(dark)); renderAllCharts(); }); /* Active nav link on scroll */ const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link')); const sections = links.map((a) => document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'))); const onScroll = () => { let current = sections[0]; sections.forEach((s) => { if (s.getBoundingClientRect().top <= 90) current = s; }); links.forEach((a) => a.classList.toggle('active', a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + current.id)); }; window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true }); /* Redraw charts on resize (debounced) */ let resizeTimer = null; window.addEventListener('resize', () => { clearTimeout(resizeTimer); resizeTimer = setTimeout(renderAllCharts, 150); }); renderYearTable(); renderProvinceTable(); renderAllCharts(); onScroll(); } document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init); ``` ### app/style.css (8034 bytes) ```css /* Statistik Indonesia — national statistics dashboard.
